newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius Harel Mallac interim 1996 profit up.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius Harel Mallac interim 1996 profit up.

text.p: Mauritian conglomerate Harel Mallac reported on Thursday a 41 percent surge in pre-tax profit to 21.9 million rupees ($1.06 million) in the six months ending 30 June, 1996, showing improved group performance.

Harel Mallac's half year turnover was lower at 215.7 million rupees from 219.6 million rupees for the corresponding period last year. Its interim after-tax profit jumped to 15.4 million rupees from 7.4 million rupees while profit attributable to group shareholders went up by 45 percent to 16.2 million rupees.

"As a result of improved performance of the holding company and most of its subsidiaries, and despite severe competition, half yearly group profits are much higher than those registered for the same period last year," a company statement said.

Harel Mallac sells agro-chemical and industrial equipment, airline tickets and tour packages, building materials, domestic appliances, office equipment and computers, sports goods, mechanical and electrical goods.
